rungs.title: Manager
rungs.summary: Leads a team and its delivery.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the work of their team and the company's policies.
rungs.delivery: Gets a team's work planned, done and reviewed.
rungs.leadership: Runs one-to-ones, sets expectations and gives honest feedback.

rungs.title: Senior Manager
rungs.summary: Leads several teams and owns outcomes.
rungs.knowledge: Understands discovery, requirements, delivery and people practice across teams.
rungs.delivery: Owns outcomes across several teams, not just tasks.
rungs.leadership: Builds other managers and negotiates priorities between teams.

rungs.title: Head of Department
rungs.summary: Sets direction and standards for a whole function.
rungs.knowledge: Reads budgets, data and the effect of AI on the function.
rungs.delivery: Sets direction and standards for a whole function and answers for results.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders; represents the function to the executive team.
